subject: insert an space between data colums

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: insert an space between data colums
parts:
Hi all
I have a data file with no space between its columns, when i import it to R, it look like as follow:
dat1 <- read.table(file="data.dat", header=F,sep="")
head(dat1)
10101
01101
01111
10111
01010
10111
dim(dat1)
1000    1
as you can see, R consider all columns as one column. i need to separate columns of my data with some space between them. how can i do it? any help?

Best

I don’t think I understand your question.  If the issue is that you can’t or don’t want to install readr (or the tidyverse, of which it is a part), Michael’s solution uses utils, which is loaded automatically when you start R.  

If that doesn’t address your concerns, maybe you could elaborate?  

Dan
